Madison Six is a Slovak MiCA-registered crypto-native platform targeting retail consumers with simple, regulated cryptocurrency buying, selling, custody, and transfer services across the EEA.

Firefish is a crypto-native, non-custodial Bitcoin-backed lending platform that connects borrowers and lenders worldwide via multisig escrow, enabling fiat and stablecoin loans without selling Bitcoin.

Okazio is a Slovak MiCA-licensed crypto asset manager targeting retail investors with ready-made investment solutions including digital lending portfolios and crypto asset management, promising approximately 10% APY through digital loans and liquidity provision.
